title: 隐私与数据安全
summary: 评估公司用户隐私与数据安全管理，包括数据泄露事件、安全体系与合规。

sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Privacy & Data Security Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how our outputs are determined. Privacy & Data Security is a Key Issue in the Social Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on the amount of personal data they collect, their exposure to evolving or increasing privacy regulations, their vulnerability to potential data breaches, and their systems for protecting personal data.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍隐私与数据安全关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解评估结果的形成方式。隐私与数据安全属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型社会支柱下的关键议题。公司评估涵盖收集个人数据的规模、变化或趋严隐私法规带来的敞口、潜在数据泄露脆弱性，以及保护个人数据的体系。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to Section 2, Data, ratings and scores, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 有关 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 2 节“数据、评级与得分”。

sections.title_en: Risks associated with this Key Issue
sections.title_cn: 与本关键议题相关的风险

blocks.content: \- Loss of revenue or unanticipated remediation and litigation costs in the event of a data breach or misuse.
blocks.content_cn: • 数据泄露或滥用导致收入损失，或产生意外补救与诉讼成本。

blocks.content: \- Damage to reputation in the event of a breach or controversy over how data is used.
blocks.content_cn: • 因数据泄露或数据使用方式争议而损害声誉。

blocks.content: \- Loss of significant market or forced change in business model if regulatory action restricts how companies may use data.
blocks.content_cn: • 若监管行动限制数据使用方式，可能丧失重要市场或被迫改变商业模式。

blocks.content: \- Increased costs to comply with new or evolving regulations.
blocks.content_cn: • 因遵守新增或变化中的法规而增加成本。

sections.title_en: Privacy & Data Security Key Issue Score
sections.title_cn: 隐私与数据安全关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Privacy & Data Security Key Issue Score evaluates the company's level of exposure to, and management of, risks on this Key Issue. The Key Issue Score on this Key Issue is based on the Exposure Score and the Management Score using the formula below. The Exposure Score and the Management Score are combined such that a higher level of exposure requires a higher level of demonstrated management capability in order to achieve the same overall Key Issue Score.
blocks.content_cn: 隐私与数据安全关键议题得分评估公司对该关键议题风险的敞口程度以及风险管理质量。该关键议题得分基于敞口得分和管理得分通过下述公式综合得出。敞口得分与管理得分的结合方式为：敞口水平越高，需要展示的管理能力也越高，才能获得相同的总体关键议题得分。

blocks.content: Where:
blocks.content_cn: 其中：

blocks.content: \- $KI_{i}$ is the Key Issue Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $KI_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的关键议题得分。

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{i}$ is the Exposure Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $MGMT_{i}$ is the Management Score for company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $MGMT_{i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的管理得分。

sections.title_cn: 隐私与数据安全管理得分

blocks.content: The Privacy & Data Security Management score is based on the weighted average of the relevant indicator scores, modified by controversies. Default indicator weights may be adjusted for the relevance of business activities; an indicator has zero weight when the company has no exposure to the activity it covers.
blocks.content_cn: 管理得分按适用指标得分加权平均，再按争议事件调整。指标采用默认权重，并可根据公司业务活动的相关性调整；公司对某指标覆盖的业务活动没有敞口时，该指标权重为零。

blocks.content: $$MGMT_i = \sum_j Indicator\_Score_{j,i} \times Indicator\_Weight_{j,i}$$

MGMT_i denotes the Management score excluding controversies; j denotes an applicable indicator and i denotes the company. Component scores aggregate indicator scores using weights scaled within the component.
blocks.content_cn: MGMT_i为争议调整前的管理得分；j表示适用指标，i表示公司。组件得分按组件内重新归一化后的指标权重汇总，不应默认将各组件等权平均。

sections.title_en: - Scope of information security management system certifications.
sections.title_cn: • 信息安全管理体系认证的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the company's information security management system certification to widely recognized standards. Best practice is for most (over 80%) of owned operations to be certified to widely recognized standards, such as ISO 27001, TRUSTe, Privacy Mark and SSAE16 soc2.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司信息安全管理体系取得广泛认可标准认证的覆盖范围。最佳实践是大部分自有运营（超过 80%）取得 ISO 27001、TRUSTe、隐私标志或 SSAE16 SOC2 等广泛认可标准认证。

sections.title_en: - Type of information security management system certification.
sections.title_cn: • 信息安全管理体系认证类型。

blocks.content: Definition: The type of information security management system certification obtained by the company (e.g., ISO 27001, TRUSTe, Privacy Mark, SSAE16 soc2 or another standard).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司取得的信息安全管理体系认证类型，例如 ISO 27001、TRUSTe、隐私标志、SSAE16 SOC2 或其他标准。

sections.title_en: - Scope of employee training on privacy and data security.
sections.title_cn: • 员工隐私与数据安全培训的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the training employees receive on data security or privacy-related risks and procedures. Best practice is for training to be provided to all employees, including contractors.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：员工接受数据安全或隐私相关风险及程序培训的覆盖范围。最佳实践是向所有员工及承包商提供培训。

sections.title_en: - Responsibility for privacy and data security.
sections.title_cn: • 隐私与数据安全责任。

blocks.content: Definition: The group (board-level committee, C-suite or executive committee, or special task force or risk officer) responsible for the company's privacy and data security strategy and performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：负责公司隐私与数据安全战略及绩效的机构，例如董事会层面委员会、高管层或执行委员会、专项工作组或风险负责人。

sections.title_cn: • 应对数据泄露的措施。

blocks.content: Definition: The scope of the data breach or incident response plan the company has in place, including whether the plan is proactive, reactive or limited in scope.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司数据泄露或事件响应计划的覆盖范围，包括计划属于主动预防、被动响应还是范围有限。

sections.title_en: • Frequency of audits of information security system.
sections.title_cn: • 信息安全体系审计频率。

blocks.content: Definition: The frequency with which the company audits its information security policies and systems.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司审计信息安全政策与体系的频率。

sections.title_en: • Collection, usage and retention of customer information.
sections.title_cn: • 客户信息的收集、使用和保留。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company commits to the principle of minimizing the amount of data handled on its customers and other individuals and does not collect personal data from third parties (except when required by law).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否承诺遵循尽量减少处理客户及其他个人数据量的原则，并且除法律要求外，不从第三方收集个人数据。

sections.title_en: - Consent policy for use of consumer data for secondary purposes.
sections.title_cn: • 消费者数据用于次级目的的同意政策。

blocks.content: Definition: The company's policy on obtaining consent before it rents, sells or provides personal data to third parties for purposes other than completing transactions/services.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司为完成交易或服务之外的目的，向第三方出租、出售或提供个人数据前获取同意的政策。

sections.title_en: - Rights provided to consumers regarding the control of their data.
sections.title_cn: • 赋予消费者控制自身数据的权利。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the rights provided by the company to individuals regarding the access, rectification and deletion of individuals' data.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司赋予个人访问、更正及删除其数据的权利范围。

sections.title_cn: • 数据保护政策的覆盖范围。

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company's data protection policy governs all or select business lines. A data protection policy must contain at least the following basic provisions: (1) clarifying collection purposes, (2) clarifying the means by which the company collects data, and (3) clarifying whether third parties have access to data and for what purposes.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司数据保护政策覆盖全部还是选定业务线。政策须至少包括以下基本条款：（1）说明收集目的；（2）说明公司收集数据的方式；（3）说明第三方是否有权访问数据及其目的。

sections.title_en: • Data protection programs covering suppliers and business partners.
sections.title_cn: • 覆盖供应商和业务伙伴的数据保护计划。

blocks.content: Definition: The extent of the company's data protection or privacy programs covering suppliers and business partners that handle the company's data or have access to the company's network. Best practice is for them to be required to have data protection policies or abide by the company's policy and for inspections to be conducted to verify their compliance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司数据保护或隐私计划覆盖处理公司数据或访问公司网络的供应商及业务伙伴的程度。最佳实践是要求其制定数据保护政策或遵守公司政策，并开展检查以核验遵守情况。

sections.title_cn: 争议事件

blocks.content: A controversy deduction ranging from 0 to 5 points is subtracted from the overall Management Score, based on the severity and type of controversies facing the company on this Key Issue. The following categories of controversies are used in the assessment:
blocks.content_cn: 根据公司在此关键议题上所涉争议的严重程度及类型，从总体管理得分中扣减 0—5 分。评估采用以下争议类别：

blocks.content: • Privacy and data security controversies.
blocks.content_cn: • 隐私与数据安全争议。

blocks.content: For more details on how controversies are included in the MSCI ESG Ratings model, refer to Section 3.3.2, Controversies cases, of "ESG Ratings Methodology."
blocks.content_cn: 关于争议如何纳入 MSCI ESG 评级模型的更多信息，参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.3.2 节“争议案例”。

sections.title_cn: 隐私与数据安全风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Privacy & Data Security Exposure Score evaluates the company's exposure to risks on this Key Issue. It is based on the product of the Business and Company-Specific Exposure Scores, combined with the Geographic Exposure Score. The Geographic Exposure Score functions as a multiplier on the Business Exposure Score and Company Specific Exposure Score, with an impact ranging from -50% to +50%. The Business Exposure Score and Geographic Exposure Score are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk. Refer to Section 3.2, Analyzing risk exposure, of “ESG Ratings Methodology” for additional details. The following formula is used in the Exposure Score calculation:
blocks.content_cn: 隐私与数据安全风险敞口得分评估公司在此关键议题上的风险敞口，以业务与公司特定风险敞口得分的乘积为基础，并结合地域风险敞口得分。地域风险敞口得分作为业务与公司特定风险敞口得分的乘数，影响范围为 -50% 至 +50%。业务与地域风险敞口得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高风险，0 分对应最低风险。详情参见《ESG 评级方法论》第 3.2 节“风险敞口分析”。风险敞口得分按以下公式计算：

blocks.content:
$$
E X P _ {P D S, i} = \big (B U S _ {P D S, i} * C O M _ {P D S, i} \big) (1 + 0. 1 \big (G E O _ {P D S, i} - 5 \big))
$$

blocks.content: \- $EXP_{PDS,i}$ is the Privacy & Data Security Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $EXP_{PDS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的隐私与数据安全风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $BUS_{PDS,i}$ is the Business Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BUS_{PDS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的业务风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $COM_{PDS,i}$ is the Company-Specific Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $COM_{PDS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的公司特定风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: \- $GEO_{PDS,i}$ is the Geographic Exposure Score of company $i$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $GEO_{PDS,i}$ 为公司 $i$ 的地域风险敞口得分。

blocks.content: The Breach Frequency Score indicates the ratio of total breach incidents as a proportion of average sales in the business activity. The Breach Cost Score indicates the cost of data breaches per lost or stolen record in a business activity. Both these indicators are scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk.
blocks.content_cn: 泄露频率得分表示该业务活动泄露事件总数与平均销售额之比。泄露成本得分表示该业务活动每条丢失或被盗记录的数据泄露成本。两项指标均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高风险，0 分对应最低风险。

blocks.content: \- $DB_{c}$ is the Data Breach Score for country $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $DB_{c}$ 为国家 $c$ 的数据泄露得分。

blocks.content: The Regulatory Score of a country is determined by a qualitative assessment of the following factors:
blocks.content_cn: 一国监管得分通过定性评估以下因素确定：

blocks.content: \- Level of restriction in national privacy and data security regulation relative to global standards.
blocks.content_cn: • 国家隐私与数据安全法规相对于全球标准的限制程度。

blocks.content: \- Likelihood of regulatory change in the next few years.
blocks.content_cn: • 未来几年监管发生变化的可能性。

blocks.content: The Data Breach Score of a country is the average of the Breach Incidence Score and the Breach Cost per Company Score, as shown below.
blocks.content_cn: 一国数据泄露得分为泄露发生情况得分与每家公司泄露成本得分的平均值，如下所示。

blocks.content: \- $BI_{c}$ is the Breach Incidence Score for country $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BI_{c}$ 为国家 $c$ 的泄露发生情况得分。

blocks.content: \- $BCC_{c}$ is the Breach Cost per Company score for country $c$ .
blocks.content_cn: • $BCC_{c}$ 为国家 $c$ 的每家公司泄露成本得分。

blocks.content: The Breach Incidence Score indicates the total number of breaches recorded in the country or region. The Breach Cost per Company Score indicates the average cost incurred per company operating in the country or region.
blocks.content_cn: 泄露发生情况得分表示国家或地区记录的泄露总次数。每家公司泄露成本得分表示在该国家或地区运营的公司平均承担的成本。

blocks.content: The Data Breach Score, Breach Incidence Score and Breach Cost per Company Score are measured on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest risk and 0 corresponding to the lowest risk.
blocks.content_cn: 数据泄露得分、泄露发生情况得分和每家公司泄露成本得分均采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高风险，0 分对应最低风险。
